row.source_text: In cases where the limitation would have expired during the period between 15.03.2020 till 28.02.2022, notwithstanding the actual balance period of limitation remaining, all persons shall have a limitation period of 90 days from 01.03.2022. In the event the actual balance period of limitation remaining, with effect from 01.03.2022 is greater than 90 days, that longer period shall apply.

row.commencement_note: The checker resumes the balance on 01.03.2022 (the day after the window) and gives max(balance, 90 days), which equals direction III: where limitation would not have expired in the window the balance always exceeds 90 days.
